_note: aniq_baseline_multitask_cnn (required baseline 2, multi-task CNN): one ResNet-50 backbone with two linear heads (crop 55, disease 175) trained jointly, loss = CE(crop) + CE(disease). Everything else identical to aniq_baseline_independent_cnn (augmentation, optimiser, validation, pair-score composition, gamma calibration), so aniq_baseline_independent_cnn vs aniq_baseline_multitask_cnn isolates independent vs shared backbone.
_result: Multi-task is slightly below the independent CNNs: harmonic mean 56.8% top-1 / 86.2% top-5 (aniq_baseline_independent_cnn: 59.7% / 87.7%), still above every CLIP version (best v4.1: 52.9%). With gamma 6.9 (epoch 13; validation mean HM 51.6%, per split 44.6% / 53.2% / 57.0%): seen top-1 50.7% (aniq_baseline_independent_cnn 54.9%), unseen top-1 64.4% (aniq_baseline_independent_cnn 65.5%); 33.8% of seen-test images go to unseen pairs. Uncalibrated it is the most seen-biased model so far: unseen top-1 5.4%, HM 10.0%, 0.1% of seen images predicted as unseen; seen top-1 67.7% (aniq_baseline_independent_cnn 67.2%), crop 89%, disease 69%. Sharing one backbone between crop and disease does not help composition here: the unseen-only diagnostic is 73.2% (aniq_baseline_independent_cnn 75.8%), and the per-pair spread is wider. A shared feature space may tie crop and disease cues together (entangled features), which is the opposite of what composing a new pair needs; the independent networks keep them apart. Per unseen pair: cucumber_powdery_mildew 95%, sugarcane_rust 89%, mango_anthracnose 83%, pepper_bell_bacterial_spot 76%, cucumber_downy_mildew 72%, tomato_early_blight 72%, grape_black_rot 54%, cherry_aphis_spp 32%, cotton_bacterial_blight 26%, corn_brown_spot 20%.

loss._note: Same as aniq_baseline_independent_cnn: CE + label smoothing 0.1; the crop and disease losses are summed with equal weight 1.0.
